name: Woppy – AI Facebook and Instagram Posts for WooCommerce
author: garganoadv

sections.description:
Woppy turns your WooCommerce product pages into ready‑to‑publish social posts for Facebook and Instagram. It reads your product data (title, description, price and image), uses AI to generate persuasive captions, and automatically publishes or schedules posts for you.

From product to post. Automatically.

Woppy was built exactly for this: it integrates promotion directly into WooCommerce, so every product can become social content without manual work. Save hours of manual social media work and keep your Facebook and Instagram pages active with regular product posts generated from your WooCommerce catalog.

The plugin connects to the Woppy service (api.woppy.io), which provides AI content and image generation capabilities and manages scheduling. The Woppy service offers a free usage tier that includes up to 10 AI‑generated posts per month. The plugin works without entering API keys: the service identifies requests by site URL; an optional account on woppy.io is only used for plan management and billing, not for activating the plugin.

Why Woppy?

Running an eCommerce store is already demanding.

Writing social posts for every product shouldn’t slow you down.

With Woppy you can:

• Generate AI-powered product posts
• Publish directly to your Facebook page
• Manage everything inside WordPress
• Keep your marketing workflow simple

How It Works (Free Version)

  1. Select a WooCommerce product
  2. Generate AI-optimized promotional content
  3. Publish directly to your connected Facebook page

Woppy handles content generation through its cloud service and returns ready-to-publish content to your dashboard.

The free version includes up to 10 AI-generated posts per month.

Premium Features

Upgrade to unlock advanced automation and scaling features:

🖼 AI Image Generation

Generate optimized promotional images starting from your product image.

📅 Post Scheduling

Schedule posts in advance directly from your WordPress dashboard.

📣 Multiple Pages Support

Connect and publish to multiple Facebook and Instagram pages.

👥 Multi-User Support

Allow multiple WordPress users to connect and manage social accounts.

Premium plans are available at woppy.io.

Free Usage

The Woppy service offers a free usage tier including:

• Up to 10 AI-generated posts per month
• Full access to core publishing features
• No API keys required

Usage limits are managed server-side by the Woppy service.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide its functionality.

1) Woppy Service (api.woppy.io)

Purpose: Generates AI content and publishes posts to connected social accounts.
Data sent:
– Site URL
– WordPress user ID
– Selected product data (title, description, price, image URL)
– Page/account identifiers
– Post content
When:
– During content generation
– When retrieving page data
– When publishing posts
– When retrieving usage quota
Provider: Woppy (Gargano Adv)
Terms: https://woppy.io/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://woppy.io/privacy-policy/

2) Woppy Auth (auth.woppy.io)

Purpose: Handles Facebook OAuth authentication.
Data sent:
– Site URL
– WordPress user ID
– OAuth parameters (redirect URL, state, nonce)
When:
– When connecting a Facebook account
Provider: Woppy (Gargano Adv)
Terms: https://woppy.io/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://woppy.io/privacy-policy/

3) Facebook / Meta Platforms

Purpose: Authentication and post publishing.
Data sent:
– OAuth tokens
– Post content
– Product information when publishing
Terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy

Support

Documentation: https://woppy.io/docs
Support: https://woppy.io/support
Website: https://woppy.io
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log into your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for Woppy
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin

After activation:

  1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  2. Go to Woppy → Social Connections
  3. Connect your Facebook account
  4. Start generating posts
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys?

No. Woppy works without manually entering API keys.

Does it work with Instagram?

Instagram publishing works via connected Facebook Pages where supported.

Is scheduling included in the free version?

No. Scheduling is available in the Premium version.

Can I connect multiple pages?

The free version supports one page connection. Premium supports multiple pages and users.
